headline: واشنطن تجدد ضربها لأهداف الحرس الثوري.. وانفجارات تهز جنوب إيران
summary: US Central Command said it began strikes on Revolutionary Guard targets. Iranian sources reported explosions at Qeshm airport and other cities in southern Iran.
why: Iran is a major oil producer, and the Strait of Hormuz on its southern coast carries a large share of global seaborne crude. Military escalation there is a key risk for energy prices.
why_moved: Renewed strikes raise fears of further disruption to Gulf oil flows, which already form part of the supply concern in the market. Crude prices are sensitive to any threat to shipping through Hormuz.
